baseline_models.focus_anchor: The restrictive frame around صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً and the sudden result clause فَإِذَا هُمْ خَامِدُونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: A single alarming sound is presented as the entire occurring input, and the fa-idha transition maps it without an intervening process onto a plural cessation of life or awareness.

activation_trace.role: Temporal occurrence makes the cry the complete event that happens.
The alarming cry supplies an abrupt harmful acoustic impulse and serves as the causal input.
Numerical singularity limits the input to one occurrence and intensifies its sufficiency.
Cessation of life or awareness after movement supplies the collective endpoint.

changed_reading.before: They died after a loud noise.
changed_reading.after: One acoustic event functions as a sudden state switch: the whole active group is immediately reduced to lifeless or unresponsive stillness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: خَامِدُونَ, especially the fire-domain branch of خ م د.
baseline_models.mechanism: The human endpoint is imaged through flame becoming quiet; because that branch can leave embers, the focus permits a distinction between ended visible activity and erased substrate without proving continued life.

activation_trace.role: A flame falling still while embers may remain supplies a cessation image that is weaker than total material erasure.

changed_reading.before: خَامِدُونَ is simply a synonym for annihilated.
changed_reading.after: Their manifest heat, motion, and agency have gone quiet like an extinguished fire; whether any residue remains is left open by the focus alone.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The singular وَاحِدَةً set against the plural pronoun and predicate هُمْ خَامِدُونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: One undivided input imposes one shared condition on a plurality, converting a group of separate agents into a synchronized collective state.

activation_trace.role: Unity in one direction or judgment lets the single cry function as a common condition imposed on the group.
Group-wide cessation supplies the one shared output state.

changed_reading.after: The verse stresses synchronization: a plural social body is collapsed by one input into a single, simultaneous condition of stillness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The narrative first expands agency from two emissaries to a reinforced third, then explicitly denies any descending supporting host immediately before the focus. Against that escalation and negation, one cry is not merely a count but an anti-logistical concentration of decisive force.

activation_trace.role: Joining one to one supplies the initial two-agent scale that the narrative then enlarges.
Reinforcement supplies deliberate augmentation of the first deployment.
The number three completes the explicit escalation in human messengers.
Delivery from above supplies the deployment channel that the immediately preceding clause negates.
A mutually supporting host supplies the large coordinated force explicitly declared unnecessary.
The single count compresses the absent force into one sufficient event.

structural_cues: 36:14 explicitly moves from two to reinforcement by a third.
36:28 immediately precedes the focus and twice negates sending down while naming a host.
36:29 restricts the whole event to one cry with إِلَّا and وَاحِدَةً.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies numeric escalation, reinforcement, and the explicit absence of a descending host; I infer that their juxtaposition with one cry creates a scale contrast. A live alternative is that 36:14 and 36:28 describe unrelated phases without calibrating the force of وَاحِدَةً.

changed_reading.before: The punishment happens to consist of one cry.
changed_reading.after: The one cry displays concentrated sufficiency: after multiplied human messengers, the decisive response requires neither deployment nor army.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later repetitions make the focus cry one instance of a recurrent single-input state-transition pattern. The same cry formula interrupts disputation in 36:49 and, in the near-identical frame of 36:53, converts dispersion or repose into total gathered presence; 36:29 supplies the inverse-looking output of collective stillness.

activation_trace.role: Cessation after movement supplies the first attested output of the single-cry pattern.
The alarming cry repeats the same abrupt acoustic input in a later scene.
Numerical singularity preserves the one-event formula across scenes.
Active mutual dispute supplies the moving social state that the later cry interrupts.
A raised sound supplies the repeated input in the frame that closely matches 36:29.
Unity under one direction supports the cry's conversion of all recipients into one coordinated state.
Gathering separated elements supplies the later collective output.
Presence and proximity specify the endpoint produced by the repeated cry.

structural_cues: 36:29 and 36:53 share إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً فَإِذَا هُمْ almost verbatim.
36:49 preserves the restrictive one-cry formula with مَا ... إِلَّا.
The three result environments differ: extinguished stillness, interruption of dispute, and gathered presence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated wording and sharply different before-and-after states; I infer a reusable state-transition operator rather than three merely similar noises. A live alternative is that the formula only marks suddenness while each cry has no shared functional profile beyond sound.

changed_reading.after: 36:29 is the first visible use of a recurrent one-cry operator that synchronously changes collective state; here its output is stillness, while later uses seize and assemble.

context_deltas.mechanism: The destroyed generations do not return to their former recipients, but the later blast produces rapid emergence from graves and is described by the raised group as departure from a resting place. This separates the focus group's irreversible end within its historical scene from permanent inability to be reactivated.

activation_trace.role: Loss of life or awareness after activity supplies the historical endpoint that requires temporal qualification.
Return to a former state supplies the movement explicitly denied for destroyed generations in relation to their successors.
A forceful emission into an instrument supplies the later activating signal.
Rapid rushing supplies renewed motion after the grave state.
Stirring a stationary thing from repose supplies explicit reactivation.
Sleep-like stillness names the prior state from which the group understands itself to have been raised.

structural_cues: 36:31 places non-return immediately after the focus's historical destruction.
36:51 repeats فَإِذَا هُم but changes the plural predicate from stillness to rapid motion.
36:52 explicitly pairs raising with a resting place.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies historical non-return followed later by blast, emergence, raising, and rest-language; I infer two temporal levels, with no return to the old communal scene but later reactivation. A live alternative is that خَامِدُونَ simply denotes death and contributes no special interim-state nuance.

changed_reading.before: Their extinguishing is unrestricted permanent erasure.
changed_reading.after: Their agency is irreversibly ended in the historical scene, but the surah's later motion out of graves prevents reading خَامِدُونَ as eternal inertia.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing description of willing a thing, saying to it, and its occurring supplies a performative speech template. Read back through that template, the focus cry can be carried not only as acoustic violence but as a sound-event whose efficacy lies in enacting an immediate commanded state.

activation_trace.role: A raised sound keeps the exploratory model anchored in the focus's audible event.
Occurrence in time supplies the focus's compressed event-to-result transition.
Affair or state supplies the domain in which the closing utterance operates.
Will supplies the initiating condition for the performative sequence.
The determinate thing supplies the recipient whose state is to occur.
Vocalized saying supplies the operative utterance between will and result.
Immediate occurrence supplies the enacted result of the utterance.

structural_cues: 36:29 compresses event and result with فَإِذَا.
36:82 compresses will, saying, and occurrence with إِذَا and فَـ.
Both clauses use restrictive framing around a minimal sufficient act.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an audible cry in 36:29 and a will-say-occur sequence in 36:82; I supply the arrow that treats the earlier sound as performative rather than merely mechanical. The materially live alternative is a purely destructive sound with no command-like function.

changed_reading.before: The cry kills by acoustic impact alone.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the cry behaves like a performative state-command: one sounded act is enough for the collective endpoint to occur.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because 36:80's green-tree ignition is remote from the human group in 36:29. It remains anchored because the focus branch explicitly images flame becoming quiet, while 36:80 supplies green material, active fire, and ignition. Downstream prose should label it a material analogy, not claim that the people are literal fuel, that the two ayat form an explicit pair, or that ember residue guarantees survival.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: خَامِدُونَ through the branch in which visible flame subsides while embers may remain.

activation_trace.role: Quieted flame with possible ember residue supplies the extinguished endpoint.
Living green plant matter supplies the unexpectedly vital source substrate.
Active kindled fire supplies the energetic state opposed to the focus's خمود.
Ignition supplies the transition into active combustion and makes extinction readable as a state reversal.

changed_reading.before: خَامِدُونَ is a static death label.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, the community's visible energy has reversed from burning activity to dormant combustion, with residue possible but not asserted.

strongest_changes: The explicit no-host prelude turns 'one' into concentrated sufficiency rather than incidental counting.
The repeated single-cry frames in 36:49 and 36:53 recast 36:29 as one output of a recurrent collective state-transition pattern.
The later blast, raising, and rapid emergence qualify the focus as a historical endpoint rather than eternal inertia.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet exposed a near-verbatim inversion: 36:29 moves by one cry to collective stillness, while 36:53 moves by one cry to total gathered presence. The surrounding no-army, resurrection, performative-speech, and fire materials made the focus read as compressed state change rather than a bare death notice.
remaining_uncertainties: The ember-residue nuance belongs to a live branch of خ م د but may be weaker here than the direct death or unconsciousness branch.
The command-like force of the cry depends on a reader-supplied link to 36:82 and should remain exploratory.
The repeated cries may share only a suddenness formula rather than one functional operator.
